code.evidence: Strict validators, explicit run gates, provider and process cleanup inspected; typecheck/build pass.
code.limits: Initial release; review findings addressed under F-001, no exhaustive correctness claim.

logic.evidence: Traced plan to execution to report, comparison, capability assessment and reviewed profile export. Four review repros committed before fixes.
logic.limits: Trusted external runner and review receipt remain attestations; no authenticated execution proof.

tests.evidence: Thirteen deterministic tests cover no-call planning, grading, exact settings, holdouts, budget/identity errors, process failures, byte limits and append-only evidence.
tests.limits: Fake providers and neutral subprocesses; no live models, coding sandbox, GPU stress or device acceptance.

documentation.evidence: README, PROTOCOL, Mac profiles, example JSON, CLI flags and area notes checked against implementation.
documentation.limits: Model profiles are proposals; smoke cases do not establish general or coding fitness.

harness.evidence: Core 4.2.1 copied/adapted mapping, check:rules/backlog/maintenance and template parity reviewed. Project settings only.
harness.limits: Initial adoption timing sample covers copy/check receipt slice, not earlier policy reading or product implementation; behavior runner unconfigured.

security.evidence: Loopback/remote metadata checks, strict command registry, no shell, bounded bytes/time, private append-only files and neutral data inspected.
security.limits: Registered code trusted; process supervision is not security isolation; no live security assessment.

delivery.evidence: Locked TypeScript 6.0.3 and Node types 24.10.1; Node >=24; pinned Actions copied from current harness; own CI and npm artifact plan reviewed.
delivery.limits: Local host Node26; Node24 Linux acceptance awaits CI; no public npm publication or hosted service.

backlog.evidence: F-001 owns release implementation and independent review; foreign NERV integration excluded from release acceptance.
backlog.limits: Pending own CI and final fresh review; no record closed from local tests.
